votes.motion: Councilor Southwick moved to adjourn into a Closed session to discuss the     character, performance or competence of an individual. Councilor Condie seconded the     motion.

Consideration of Resolution #2023-44 approving a cooperative agreement between UDOT and Lehi City for improvements at the intersection of 2100 North and 2300 West. Brad Kenison, Assistant City Engineer, presented the agreement to the Council. They anticipate the construction will begin in 2024.

Consideration of Resolution #2023-43 approving a Real Estate Purchase Contract for the property at 51 East Main Street, Lehi. Marlin Eldred, Economic Development Director, presented the agreement to the Council. The property is being used as a rental at the time, and the contract allowed it to be utilized as such

Consideration of Resolution #2023-42 approving an agreement with RBI for the irrigation system construction in Willow Park. Steve Marchbanks, Parks and Facilities Manager, presented the agreement to the Council. They plan to install a water main line to water the newly planted trees and improve the park.

Consideration of Resolution #2023-41 approving an agreement with Ice-America for the construction of a temporary ice rink. Mr. Marchbanks presented the agreement to the Council. Consideration of Concept approval for the Griffith Estates Concept, a 9-unit townhome PUD (Planned Unit Development) subdivision located at 300 East 1630 South. Steve Potter was representing the applicant. He provided an update on the soil study, which showed positive results for building on native soil.

Consideration of Resolution #2023-40 approving an Amendment to the Lehi Tennis Club Development Agreement. The petitioner, Jacob Hansen, presented some adjustments he wanted to make to the agreement due to changes in the project's economics.

Consideration of Ordinance #41-2023 approving a Development Code Amendment to Chapter 39, Definitions and the 05.030.B, Nonresidential Table of Uses to add Concrete Manufacturing, Small Haul use and definition. The petitioner Jeff Olson presented his application to the Council.
Consideration of approval for the Cyprus Credit Union Two-Lot Subdivision with No Improvements located at 2501 North 1200 West in a Commercial Zone.
